BENCHMARK — 7 approved indications. Q2W SC dosing is the patient-reported inconvenience gap. 10–20% conjunctivitis rate in AD. TMDD limits half-life extension. ~$14.2B revenue 2024. All IL-4Rα×TSLP positioning is vs. dupilumab as the comparator.

NAVIGATOR: 70% AAER reduction vs placebo across all endotypes including low-eos (<150). Treatment policy estimand. AZ SUNRISE COPD Ph3 positive — label expansion imminent. Most direct competitor to TSLP arm of Ailux bispecific.

CATT Ph3 — 8th indication push. CSU is anti-histamine refractory population. If positive, confirms IL-4Rα as platform across all type 2 diseases. Framing for bispecific: each new dupilumab indication de-risks IL-4Rα×TSLP in that same indication.

IL-4Rα × TSLP bispecific from China. Phase 1 ongoing. Global rights available. Innovent has a track record of out-licensing to global partners. Direct format competitor to Ailux; lacks pH engineering and extended half-life platform.

Biosion's TSLP×IL-4R bispecific following their bosakitug (anti-TSLP) program. Phase 1 safety ongoing. Same mechanism as Ailux but without pH-engineering. Biosion's bosakitug already licensed to Aclaris ($900M), so BSI-502 global partnership is likely the next target.

Multiple pediatric label expansion programs ongoing for dupilumab. COPD 6-month primary analysis positive (BOREAS/NOTUS). Additional data in pediatric age groups will further entrench IL-4Rα franchise and raise the bar for next-gen bispecifics.
